title: Northstar synthetic plan: deductible
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. The Northstar sample plan has an annual in-network deductible of 500 dollars for individual coverage and 1,000 dollars for family coverage. The deductible year runs from January 1 through December 31. A covered member pays eligible in-network charges until their applicable deductible is met, after which the plan's listed copayment or coinsurance applies. The family deductible uses a shared family accumulator: amounts paid by covered family members contribute to the stated 1,000 dollar family amount. This synthetic rule does not describe an embedded individual deductible. Out-of-network charges do not count toward either in-network deductible in this sample policy. Preventive services listed in a separate schedule are exempt from the deductible when delivered by an in-network provider. The sample does not state a maximum out-of-pocket amount, so a question about that value is unanswerable from this document. Dollar amounts here are invented for retrieval evaluation and must never be represented as a real person's benefits.
